Test Case Description: Verify end-to-end encryption of authentication data transmission
Pre-Condition: Network inspection tool available; non-production environment

Expected Result: Authentication data is transmitted with end-to-end encryption; plaintext credentials are not exposed

Expected Result: Excessive login requests are throttled/blocked (rate limiting), preventing brute force attacks

Expected Result: Passwords are stored as hashed values using an industry-standard hashing algorithm; plaintext is never stored
